Complete the Software Development Plan

## Goal

Write the plan your team will build from. In Week 8, your instructor syncs with every team to go over the plan and approve the app.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `SOFTWARE_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md` is at the root of the repo, with every placeholder replaced.
- [ ] Team roles use GitHub usernames, not real names.
- [ ] The MVP scope includes an out-of-scope list.
- [ ] The Data section lists tables or API resources, their fields, and the screens that use them.
- [ ] All six weeks are planned. Sprints 1–4 each have a goal and 3–6 deliverables with owners, and Sprint 3 accounts for Thanksgiving.
- [ ] There are at least five measurable success criteria, each with an owner.
- [ ] The plan is merged into `develop` through a reviewed pull request.

## Where to look

Canvas: [Team] Software Development Plan & Wireframes and Sample Software Development Plan.
